beliefs: f removes all whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines, carriage returns, and Unicode whitespace like NBSP, em space, vertical tab, ideographic space) from the input [E1, E2]
f leaves all other characters (letters, digits, punctuation) unchanged [E1]
f maps empty string to empty string [E1]
notes: E2 shows f strips all whitespace, not just ASCII spaces. Switched to removing any character where str.isspace() is true, which covers tabs, newlines, NBSP, em space, vertical tab, and ideographic space.
